title: Analysis by Merrick's colleagues points to a Tic Tac-shaped craft

tellings.quote: but I have fairly high confidence that that was a tick tap shake craft

related.note: An analysis of the same FLIR1 footage that concludes it shows a Tic Tac-shaped craft, against telling 6's distant aircraft.

plain: The analyst Marik von Rennenkampff says that analysis by colleagues, including an unnamed scientist in California, gives him "fairly high confidence" that the object in the FLIR1 video was a craft shaped like a Tic Tac. FLIR1 is infrared camera footage filmed from a Navy jet off Southern California in 2004. The object is the "Tic Tac," a white oval shaped like the mint. He says this in a debate with the skeptic Mick West, who reads the same video as an ordinary object.
